title: add-benchmark-lab-reporting-pipeline-v56
author: Emily Zhang
description: Add benchmark-lab reporting pipeline v56: multi-variant reporting + profiling baseline ingestion + representative workload runner updates. Motivation: consolidate multiple ad-hoc reporting jobs into a single maintainable DAG that supports multi-variant experiments, richer profiling baselines, and per-workload rollups used by the Benchmark Lab dashboards and the automated regression alerts. This PR implements the pipeline scaffold, ingestion adapters for profiler baselines (Flamegraph and allocation summaries), a normalized metrics schema, representative workload runner metadata enrichment, and connectors to long-term storage (GCS/BigQuery). Checklist: - [x] Pipeline DAG and task operators implemented - [x] Profiler baseline ingestion + normalizer - [x] Representative workload runner adapter + metadata mapping - [x] Aggregation and rollup tasks (per-model, per-variant, per-workload) - [x] Tests: unit + integration harness - [x] Docs + runbook updates - [x] Dashboard queries + example panel definitions Changes are backwards-compatible: existing reporting jobs are preserved; v56 is opt-in via pipeline config. Rollout plan: deploy pipeline in staging, collect 48h of data, validate regression metrics against v55 baselines, then flip traffic in production and monitor alerts. Notes: we intentionally keep the normalization step isolated so downstream dashboards can consume either raw or normalized metrics. The description and changelog include examples of the normalized schema and mapping from existing tags.
